title: argus-autonomy: wildfire detection, confirmation and response for a single UAV
description: Simulation study of wildfire autonomy for a single UAV, in three layers. Detect: cue-free patrol from a dock with a hazard-aware occupancy filter. Confirm: a sequential test between a spreading-fire model and a static-world model that discriminates decoys, with thresholds chosen on selection seeds and reported on held-out seeds. Respond: a responder brief, an ensemble forecast of the affected area, and a closed-form feasibility model of dock-launched suppression. All under a geofence and a return-to-base monitor. Every milestone is pre-registered; design documents and results are in docs/design/ and results/. The technical report in docs/report/ covers v1.0-v1.1.
